answer: The locksmith keeps his wards in a small tin box, and no key leaves the shop until it has been tried three times in the lock. Proof of locksmith key via ward cut record is the trying: a key the smith files only after 5 wards are cut true, each ward tried in the same lock. The lagoon is the first ward, cut at the bench; the tundra is the fifth, cut when the bolt first slid. A cheat must cut 23 false wards and try 23 false keys, and the kernel still opens no door for him.
